verdict.rationale: The evidence documents the Dataverse Web API and says third-party libraries can generate classes. However, nothing in the pack names or links a downloadable machine-readable spec, such as an OpenAPI document or a metadata document. The OpenAPI probes against the docs host all returned 404, so no first-party spec download is evidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
